about: The method papers whose forward citations level B searches (validation/plans/level_b_protocol.md, section 2; approved by the owner on 2026-10-19). Each is found in Europe PMC by its query and must match its expected journal (ISO abbreviation), year and title words exactly once among the journal articles; the lookup's run (label level-b-lookup) records the match, and its Europe PMC source and id are then written here as 'verified' before the search runs.
